scripts.db:tables: wrangler d1 execute selenia-aroma --remote --yes --command "select name from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name"
scripts.db:tables:local: wrangler d1 execute selenia-aroma --local --command "select name from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name"
scripts.db:counts: wrangler d1 execute selenia-aroma --remote --yes --command "select 'stores' t, count(*) n from stores union all select 'profiles', count(*) from profiles union all select 'base_blends', count(*) from base_blends union all select 'essential_oils', count(*) from essential_oils union all select 'mood_categories', count(*) from mood_categories"
